migrationReadonlySources.consistencyPolicy: map source deposit receipts to DepositLedger received/confirmed transaction entries during explicit remediation only
derive liability from DepositLedger transaction event log; do not double-count source liability rows
convert only non-deposit ordinary payment rows; deposit purpose rows migrate to DepositLedger
attach to converted PaymentLedger payment ids by original payment_id
sourceLock as audit trace unless explicitly mapped to a ledger confirmation event

guards: CheckIn persistence must not write new ledger fact tables
PeriodAnalytics and risk lenses must not sum source and current ledger facts together
Remediation must be dry-run first and must be idempotent
